description: This PHP class handles normalization and denormalization of JSON:API top-level documents, including validation, schema generation, and processing of resource data, relationships, errors, and omissions within Drupal's JSON:API module.

classes.name: JsonApiDocumentTopLevelNormalizer
classes.description: Handles normalization and denormalization of JSON:API top-level documents, including validation, schema generation, and processing of resource data, relationships, errors, and omissions within Drupal's JSON:API module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes entity type manager and resource type repository dependencies.

methods.name: denormalize
methods.description: Converts JSON:API document data into Drupal entity objects, validating structure and handling relationships.

methods.name: doNormalize
methods.description: Converts Drupal entity data into JSON:API top-level document format, including data, errors, included resources, omissions, and links.

methods.name: normalizeErrorDocument
methods.description: Normalizes error collections into JSON:API error format.

methods.name: normalizeOmissionsLinks
methods.description: Converts omitted data into a set of links with metadata for the JSON:API document.

methods.name: validateRequestBody
methods.description: Performs validation checks on incoming JSON:API request bodies for correct structure and UUID formatting.

methods.name: getLinkHash
methods.description: Generates a short hash for omitted links to ensure uniqueness.

methods.name: getNormalizationSchema
methods.description: Provides JSON schema for the top-level JSON:API document based on its data type.

methods.name: getSchemasForDataCollection
methods.description: Generates JSON schemas for resource types within a data collection.

methods.name: getSupportedTypes
methods.description: Returns supported normalization types, specifically the JsonApiDocumentTopLevel class.
